caseNameFull: BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF THE VILLAGE OF SCARSDALE v. McCREARY
attorneys: Marvin E. Frankel argued the cause for petitioners. With him on the briefs was Marc D. Stern., Marvin Schwartz argued the cause for respondents and filed a brief for respondents Scarsdale Creche Committee et al. Vincent K. Gilmore filed a brief for respondents McCreary et al.*

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Justice Powell took no part in the decision of this case.
